seo.overviewTitle: LLM Workflow Integration & API Pipeline Design (LangChain / LlamaIndex)
seo.overviewBody: Integrating LLMs into production web applications requires robust API pipeline orchestration. Software engineers showcase skills by building LLM pipelines with LangChain/LlamaIndex/Vercel AI SDK, streaming responses via Server-Sent Events (SSE), and configuring multi-provider fallback layers.

deliverables.title: 1. LLM Application Pipeline Architecture Spec
deliverables.desc: Integration blueprint mapping API request pipelines, model orchestration frameworks, and caching layers.

deliverables.title: 2. Response Streaming & UI Integration Spec
deliverables.desc: Specification establishing Server-Sent Events (SSE) streaming from backend LLM APIs to front-end UI components.

deliverables.title: 3. Multi-Provider LLM Fallback Strategy
deliverables.desc: Failover spec routing queries automatically to secondary providers (e.g. OpenAI to Anthropic/Gemini) on API timeouts.

faqs.question: Why is streaming responses via Server-Sent Events (SSE) crucial for UX?
faqs.answer: Streaming renders response tokens in real-time as they generate, reducing perceived latency from seconds to milliseconds for end users.

faqs.question: When should you use raw LLM SDKs versus frameworks like LangChain?
faqs.answer: Use raw SDKs (OpenAI/Anthropic) for lightweight, custom, performance-critical applications. Use LangChain/LlamaIndex for complex multi-step chaining and quick RAG prototyping.

faqs.question: How do you handle rate limits (429 errors) when calling LLM APIs?
faqs.answer: Implement exponential backoff retries with random jitter, and configure automatic fallback routing to alternative model endpoints.
